description:
Cancel a running BigQuery job.

Use this tool to cancel a query job that is currently executing (i.e. returned `jobComplete: false`
with a `jobId` from `execute_sql` or `execute_sql_readonly`). Specify the `jobId` to abort.

jobId.description: Required. Job ID of the job to cancel.

location.description: Required. The geographic location of the job.

projectId.description: Required. Project ID of the job to cancel.

name: google-bigquery__cancel_job
